finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
finding.summary: the file request parameter, already percent-decoded once by the servlet container, is passed through a second URLDecoder.decode() call that turns the inert literal %2e%2e%2f into ../, so the subsequent ".." containment check runs on the pre-decode value and passes before the traversal-bearing filename reaches new File(ATTACHMENTS_DIR, filename)
